versions.changelog:
dress-designer v1.0.0

- Initial release of Agentic AI Dress Designer for generating customized dress designs for print on demand (POD) and manufacturing on demand (MOD).
- Supports structured clothing parameters, reference images, customized text and logos, interactive 3D viewers, and multi-view design generation.
- Includes comprehensive workflow for concept design, 3D preview, customization, and manufacturing integration.
- REST API endpoint for generating design drafts via text, parameters, and templates.
- Quick start instructions and prompt examples for a variety of clothing types beyond dresses.
